Author: xduduking
Name: dudu的書
Punchline: Smart player messages translation tool for FF14
Description:
Smart player messages translation tool for FF14

Listens to the chat channels you choose and echoes a translation back in your target language. Japanese can show romaji and Chinese can show pinyin in parentheses. Sends translated messages on your active channel via /jp and /zh. Open settings with /ducfg, /duconfig, or /duduconfig.
Changelog: 0.1.24.0: FF14 terms now follow your target language. Translating Japanese into Chinese or Indonesian no longer leaves English jargon in the result: 安置どこ？ now comes out as 安全點在哪裡？ or "Dimana titik aman?" instead of keeping "safe spot". Common lines like よろしくお願いします, お疲れ様でした or 草 are written directly in your target language, and primal names use their in-game names (シヴァ → 希瓦 in Chinese). English translations are unchanged.
